Individual native discrepancies, routes, endpoints, junctions, crossings, omission and independent registration remain unestablished; external schema status is unestablished. Team3 reports the AD output glyph on native tile 2-2 appears B07 while the source records D07; the possible discrepancy requires close independent confirmation, and D07 remains the source claim without an assumed correction. The source has 88 unresolved endpoints, 36 unlabeled contacts, qualifiers and distinct same-pin input/output records. Block and independent edge fits disagree by up to 25.311 px. The other 15 native tiles, 17 junctions, 40 crossings, full routes, omissions and local warp remain unassessed. Twenty-five generated route sections were not inspected; three zero-length segments and 40 unjoined entries are leads only.
